title: "scRNA-seq PBS vs AEC: cell-cell communication"

output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: inline

Single cell RNA-seq of one PBS-treated and one AEC-treated mouse. Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender.
This script was written for Seurat v4. To run it with Seurat v5, keep `options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")` in the setup chunk.

Immune subtypes for cell-cell communication, CellChat and LIANA in PBS and AEC.
Starts from the objects in `data/cell/` saved by `01_QC_integration_annotation.Rmd`. `data/cell/Cell_Myeloid2.rds` is saved by `02_myeloid_cells.Rmd`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r Data to do interaction}
DATA_Immune <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune.rds")
DATA_Immune <- SetIdent(DATA_Immune, value = "Celltypes")

#Myeloid Cells----
DATA_Myeloid <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Myeloid2.rds")
DATA_Myeloid$Subtypes <- paste0("Myeloid_",DATA_Myeloid$seurat_subclusters)

#B Cells----
# CCA_snn_res.0.1 here is the clustering of the whole dataset, not the B cell subclustering
DATA_B <- subset(DATA_Immune, idents = c("B Cell"))
DATA_B$Subtypes <- paste0("B_",DATA_B$CCA_snn_res.0.1)

#Other immune cells keep their cell type----
DATA_Other <- subset(DATA_Immune, idents = c("Mast Cell", "T Cell", "Neutrophil", "Dendritic Cells"))
DATA_Other$Subtypes <- DATA_Other$Celltypes

#Merge the Data----
DATA_immune2 = merge(DATA_Myeloid, c(DATA_B, DATA_Other))
table(DATA_immune2$Celltypes,DATA_immune2$Subtypes)
#Save the DATA----
saveRDS(DATA_immune2,"data/cell/Cell_Immune_sub.rds" )

```

```{r Cellchat}
#load the Dataset with Subtypes
DATA <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune_sub.rds" )
table(DATA$Celltypes,DATA$Subtypes)

DATA_PBS <-SetIdent(DATA, value = "Condition") %>% subset(idents = "PBS")
DATA_PBS <- NormalizeData(DATA_PBS)
DATA_AEC <-SetIdent(DATA, value = "Condition") %>% subset(idents = "AEC")
DATA_AEC <- NormalizeData(DATA_AEC)

#Set the database to be used----
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
showDatabaseCategory(CellChatDB)
# use all CellChatDB for cell-cell communication analysis
CellChatDB.use <- CellChatDB # simply use the default CellChatDB

# Remove the warning (ligands not in the mouse genome)----
CellChatDB.use[["interaction"]] <- CellChatDB.use[["interaction"]][!CellChatDB.use[["interaction"]]$ligand %in% c("H2-BI", "H2-Ea-ps"),]

#PBS group----
#Make CellChat object from Seurat
data.input <- LayerData(DATA_PBS, assay = "RNA", layer  = "data") # normalized data matrix
labels <-SetIdent(DATA_PBS, value = "Subtypes") %>% Idents()
meta <- data.frame(group = labels, row.names = names(labels)) # create a dataframe of the cell labels
cellchat_PBS <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "group")
# set the used database in the object
cellchat_PBS@DB <- CellChatDB.use
# subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
cellchat_PBS <- subsetData(cellchat_PBS) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
cellchat_PBS <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat_PBS)
cellchat_PBS <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat_PBS)
cellchat_PBS <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_PBS)
# Filter out the cell-cell communication if there are only few number of cells in certain cell groups
cellchat_PBS <- filterCommunication(cellchat_PBS, min.cells = 10)
cellchat_PBS <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_PBS)
cellchat_PBS <- aggregateNet(cellchat_PBS)

#AEC group----
#Make CellChat object from Seurat
data.input <- LayerData(DATA_AEC, assay = "RNA", layer  = "data") # normalized data matrix
labels <-SetIdent(DATA_AEC, value = "Subtypes") %>% Idents()
meta <- data.frame(group = labels, row.names = names(labels)) # create a dataframe of the cell labels
cellchat_AEC <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "group")
# set the used database in the object
cellchat_AEC@DB <- CellChatDB.use
# subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
cellchat_AEC <- subsetData(cellchat_AEC) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
cellchat_AEC <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat_AEC)
cellchat_AEC <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat_AEC)
cellchat_AEC <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_AEC)
cellchat_AEC <- filterCommunication(cellchat_AEC, min.cells = 10)
cellchat_AEC <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_AEC)
cellchat_AEC <- aggregateNet(cellchat_AEC)

saveRDS(list(PBS = cellchat_PBS, AEC = cellchat_AEC), "results/cell/Cellchat/cellchat_objects.rds")

#Celltypes circle graph----
for (cc in c("PBS", "AEC")) {
cellchat <- get(paste0("cellchat_", cc))
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
mat <- cellchat@net$weight
pdf(file = paste0("results/cell/Cellchat/", cc, "_celltypes.pdf"), width = 12, height =10 )
par(mfrow = c(3,5), xpd=TRUE, mar=c(1,1,1,1))
for (i in 1:nrow(mat)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = rownames(mat)[i])}
dev.off()

#circle graph with pathway----
pdf(file = paste0("results/cell/Cellchat/", cc, "_pathway.pdf"), width = 9, height =16 )
par(mfrow = c(5,3), xpd=TRUE, mar=c(1,1,1,1))
for(i in cellchat@netP$pathways){
netVisual_aggregate(cellchat, signaling = i, layout = "circle")
}
dev.off()

#Chord graph for pathway----
pdf(file = paste0("results/cell/Cellchat/", cc, "_Chord.pdf"), width = 9, height =16 )
par(mfrow = c(5,3), xpd=TRUE, mar=c(1,1,1,1))
for(i in cellchat@netP$pathways){
netVisual_aggregate(cellchat, signaling = i, layout = "chord")
}
dev.off()
}

par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=T)
netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat_PBS, sources.use = c(1:15), targets.use = 12, legend.pos.x = 15)
netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat_AEC, sources.use = c(1:15), targets.use = 12, legend.pos.x = 15)

plot_grid(
netVisual_bubble(cellchat_PBS, sources.use = c(1:16), targets.use = c(2,3,5), remove.isolate = T),
netVisual_bubble(cellchat_AEC, sources.use = c(1:16), targets.use = c(2,3,5), remove.isolate = T))

netVisual_bubble(cellchat_PBS, sources.use = c(1:15), targets.use = c(12),signaling = c("MHC-II"), remove.isolate = FALSE)

#Signal network of each pathway in PBS and AEC----
pathways.show <- c("GALECTIN", "TGFb", "APP", "CCL", "MIF", "SPP1", "SEMA4", "CSF", "FN1", "ICAM", "CD52", "CD45", "MHC-II", "CD86", "JAM", "VISFATIN", "COMPLEMENT", "PROS", "CADM", "GRN", "PTPRM", "GAS", "CD80", "THBS", "LAMININ", "PECAM1", "SELPLG", "TNF", "THY1", "ITGAL-ITGB2", "CD22", "CD48", "CD39", "IL4", "ICOS", "CXCL", "IL2", "VCAM", "KIT", "OSM", "SEMA7", "IGF", "NGL", "IL1", "IL6", "ALCAM", "CD6", "BAFF", "CD200", "VEGF", "NECTIN", "IL16", "CD96", "TWEAK", "CD226", "SN", "NRG", "PVR", "ACTIVIN", "PD-L1", "PDL2", "MHC-I", "SELL")
pathways.show <- intersect(pathways.show, intersect(cellchat_PBS@netP$pathways, cellchat_AEC@netP$pathways))

pdf(file ="results/cell/Cellchat/cellchat_signal.pdf", width = 18, height =40)
par(mfrow = c(8,4))
for (a in pathways.show){
    netVisual_chord_cell(cellchat_PBS, signaling = a,  title.name = paste0(a, " signaling network in PBS"))
    netVisual_chord_cell(cellchat_AEC, signaling = a,  title.name = paste0(a, " signaling network in AEC"))
}
dev.off()

```

```{r Liana}
DATA <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune_sub.rds" )
table(DATA$Celltypes,DATA$Subtypes)
DATA_PBS <-SetIdent(DATA, value = "Condition") %>% subset(idents = "PBS")
DATA_PBS <- NormalizeData(DATA_PBS) %>% SetIdent(value = "Subtypes")
DATA_AEC <-SetIdent(DATA, value = "Condition") %>% subset(idents = "AEC")
DATA_AEC <- NormalizeData(DATA_AEC) %>% SetIdent(value = "Subtypes")

op_resource <- select_resource("Consensus")[[1]]

# Generate orthologous resource
ortholog_resource <- generate_homologs(op_resource = op_resource,
                                       target_organism = 10090) # mouse

# Run LIANA with the orthologous resource
liana_PBS <- liana_wrap(DATA_PBS,
                        resource = 'custom', # resource has to be set to 'custom' to work with external resources
                        external_resource = ortholog_resource # provide orthologous resource
                        )

liana_AEC <- liana_wrap(DATA_AEC,
                        resource = 'custom', # resource has to be set to 'custom' to work with external resources
                        external_resource = ortholog_resource # provide orthologous resource
                        )
liana_PBS <- liana_PBS %>% liana_aggregate()
liana_AEC <- liana_AEC %>% liana_aggregate()
liana_PBS.f <-liana_PBS%>%filter(aggregate_rank <= 0.01)# only keep interactions concordant between methods
liana_AEC.f <-liana_AEC%>%filter(aggregate_rank <= 0.01)# only keep interactions concordant between methods
write.csv(liana_PBS, "results/cell/LIANA/liana_PBS.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(liana_AEC, "results/cell/LIANA/liana_AEC.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#frequency chord diagram
par(mar = c(8,8,8,8))
chord_freq(liana_PBS.f)
chord_freq(liana_AEC.f)
#frequency heatmap
heat_freq(liana_PBS.f)
heat_freq(liana_AEC.f)

#Dotplot for each myeloid subcluster as source----
for(i in paste0("Myeloid_", 0:8)){
  print(i)
a<-liana_dotplot(liana_PBS.f, source_groups = i,
              target_groups = unique(liana_PBS$target)
                ,ntop = 30) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text( size=10, angle=90), axis.text.y = element_text( size=10)) + ggtitle(paste0("PBS ",i))

b<-liana_dotplot(liana_AEC.f, source_groups =i,
              target_groups = unique(liana_AEC$target)
              ,ntop = 30) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text( size=10, angle=90), axis.text.y = element_text( size=10))+ ggtitle(paste0("AEC ",i))
pdf(file = paste0("results/cell/LIANA/",i,"_source.pdf"),height = 8, width = 20)
print(plot_grid(a,b))
dev.off()
}
```
